item.rsgauges.switchlink_pearl.help:
Click a switch with an Ender Pearl
 to link it. With the Switch Link Pearl
 in your main hand, sneak and use it
 to activate that switch remotely.
 Use it on another switch to link the
 two. Click the target with the pearl
 to cycle the link modes. A source can
 hold more than one pearl. The pearl
 makes a sound if it cannot activate
 its target or link to a switch.
